name: Sensu Fan
description: A folding fan that spreads its ribs from a pivot and unfolds a pleated leaf with a picture, or a menu, printed across it.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the fan is pressed, or Escape is pressed while it is open.

props.name: angle
props.description: The arc the fan spreads through when open, in degrees, from 40 to 180.

props.name: ribs
props.description: Number of ribs, the two guard sticks included. Each gap holds one pleat of two faces.

props.name: children
props.description: The picture printed across the leaf, usually an img with object-cover. It fills a 480 by 276 box whose bottom centre is the pivot.

props.name: items
props.type: { id: string; label: string; icon?: ReactNode }[]
props.description: Menu mode: one item per pleat, set along the pleat. The fan then has one rib more than items, and only its handle toggles it.

props.name: onAction
props.description: Called with the id of the pressed item. Arrow keys move between items; Escape folds the fan.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the fan, and of the menu in menu mode. Describe the picture here.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root. It is up to 480 pixels wide and scales down to fit. Also accepts every other prop of a div.
